content.rationale: One test crate covers the set read's ten edges. It checks the artifact's shape and the result contract: one mapping `jj log` and one `git cat-file --batch` for the healthy set, with no per-node `file show` (fidelity to D-read-bulk and S2-read-set); the batch reads `nodes/<id>.json` from the commit the change id names, not the working copy (fidelity to S2-read-set and xwyryumr); the requests name the mapped commits (fidelity to xwyryumr); every result matches the single-document read (conformance to T-bulk-read); absence is preserved; one missing/non-blob object falls back for that id and still matches; a mapping failure or a git spawn/non-zero falls back for the whole set with no node lost; a non-colocated or absent git runner falls back; a divergent change falls back per id; and the batch receives `<commit>:nodes/<id>.json` for the mapped commits.
